description: This file manages session write locks, including acquiring, releasing, and cleaning stale lock files. It handles process signals for cleanup, maintains lock state, and includes testing utilities.

classes.name: SessionLockInspection
classes.description: Represents the inspection details of a session lock, including its path, process info, age, and stale status.

methods.name: resolveSessionLockMaxHoldFromTimeout
methods.description: Calculates maximum lock hold time based on timeout, grace, and minimum parameters.

methods.name: releaseHeldLock
methods.description: Releases a held lock, optionally forcing release.

methods.name: releaseAllLocksSync
methods.description: Synchronously releases all held locks, used during process exit.

methods.name: runLockWatchdogCheck
methods.description: Checks and releases locks held longer than their max hold time.

methods.name: ensureWatchdogStarted
methods.description: Starts the lock watchdog timer if not already running.

methods.name: handleTerminationSignal
methods.description: Handles process termination signals to release locks and possibly re-raise signals.

methods.name: registerCleanupHandlers
methods.description: Registers process handlers for cleanup and signals.

methods.name: unregisterCleanupHandlers
methods.description: Removes registered cleanup and signal handlers.

methods.name: readLockPayload
methods.description: Reads and parses lock file payload.

methods.name: inspectLockPayload
methods.description: Inspects lock payload to determine if it is stale or valid.

methods.name: lockInspectionNeedsMtimeStaleFallback
methods.description: Determines if fallback mtime check is needed for stale lock detection.

methods.name: shouldReclaimContendedLockFile
methods.description: Decides if a stale lock file should be reclaimed based on its age and status.

methods.name: shouldTreatAsOrphanSelfLock
methods.description: Checks if the current process should treat a lock as an orphan self-lock.
